# Per-variant hook lifecycle routes

**UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL.** Generated by `scripts/generate-lifecycle-routes-by-variant.mjs`; do not hand-edit. Regenerate with `npm run lifecycle:routes-by-variant`.

Plain-words answer to *"after you deploy, who runs each hook?"* per chart **and per built variant**. Derived from committed inputs only (the chart-level route set in `data/lifecycle-route-actions/`, each base's `variant.yaml`, and the matrix's per-base disposition). Nothing runs automatically (`automatic: false`).

Charts: 13 · with a real per-variant delta: 3 (argo-cd/argo-workflows, kyverno/kyverno, prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack).

| Base | Hook (route) | After deploy, who runs it? | Per-base change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| controller-default-reviewed (needs 8 CRDs) | crd-install → `preflight-or-presync-crd-apply` | You — before deploy (install the required CRDs first) | prerequisite (this base does not install the 8 CRDs — supply them before deploy (e.g. via the default base or your platform)) |
| default (needs 8 CRDs) | crd-install → `preflight-or-presync-crd-apply` | You — before deploy (install the required CRDs first) | prerequisite (this base does not install the 8 CRDs — supply them before deploy (e.g. via the default base or your platform)) |
| minimal-crds | crd-install → `preflight-or-presync-crd-apply` | Handled — this base installs the CRDs | resolved (this base installs the required CRDs (observed live)) |
